verified_native_pipeline: Default highlight recovery enabled; Auto demosaic; false-color/green-equilibration/impulse/fringe adjustments disabled.
Per-photosite white balance (including second green) precedes demosaic.
Camera XYZ-to-camera metadata feeds camera-to-linear-sRGB matrix; matrix applies after demosaic/highlight processing; output remains unclamped linear RGB.
comparison_model_limit: Current photometric gain/offset fits each RGB channel independently. It cannot represent cross-channel color mixing caused by different 3x3 color transforms. This is a model limitation, not proof that the observed rejection is caused by a matrix mismatch.
next_discriminating_experiment: Fit diagnostic full3x3-plus-offset mapping using only a fixed training subset of aligned in-range opaque pairs; measure both directions on disjoint spatially interleaved samples, retain highlight residuals and negative controls. Do not promote acceptance from in-sample fit or discard original failed references.
scope: Current source audit plus experiment design; no production algorithm/threshold change, no new full-matrix measurements.
